dxgive.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/3] Seven of 56 participants (12.5%) were excluded for major depression, and the remainder declined due to time or distance factors (n = 8). Of the 41 participants randomized, 10 qualified by CDI score alone (24.4%), 13 by CDI-P score alone (31.7%), and 18 by both (43.9%). [page/4/Text/15] At T1 12 participants in PASCET-PI group and 10 participants in the comparison group had depressive symptom counts consistent with minor depression.
